title: The new operator-facing [loop] orch_context_window key (default 200000) is docu…
description:
The new operator-facing [loop] orch_context_window key (default 200000) is documented in ADR-0028 and the context-window.ts JSDoc but has no commented example line in project.toml alongside meta_loop/worker_isolation. Consider a commented sample to aid discoverability. Non-blocking: PRD explicitly makes setting it optional.

Source: cam/issue-172
Review round: 1
Location: scripts/cam/project.toml:18

suggestion-fingerprint: d54f68293715

spec.scope: Add commented example lines to cam-cli's own scripts/cam/project.toml [loop] section documenting orch_context_window (default 200000), and while editing the same block, comment meta_loop and worker_isolation with their accepted values. Config-file discoverability only, cam-cli dogfood file only. No code change. The cam init scaffold discoverability is explicitly out of scope (tracked separately in CAM-283).
acceptanceCriteria: scripts/cam/project.toml [loop] section carries a commented example line for orch_context_window showing the default value 200000, consistent with DEFAULT_ORCH_CONTEXT_WINDOW at src/config/models.ts:324 and the reader readOrchContextWindow at src/config/models.ts:343-357.

meta_loop and worker_isolation get a short commented note of their accepted values (meta_loop: auto | observe | off; worker_isolation: container | host), consistent with readMetaLoop (src/config/models.ts:241) and readWorkerIsolation (src/config/models.ts:306).

orch_context_window remains a COMMENTED example (not an active uncommented key) so the runtime default (200000) continues to apply unchanged; meta_loop and worker_isolation keep their existing active values, only gaining a comment.
The file still parses and no effective config value changes: bun run typecheck, bun test, bun run check:all all green.
Scope is limited to scripts/cam/project.toml in cam-cli; no change to cam init scaffolding (out of scope, CAM-283).
gotchas: The TOML serializer stringifyToml (src/config/toml.ts:68-96) cannot emit # comments; this must be a direct hand-edit of scripts/cam/project.toml, NOT routed through mergeIntoConfig/stringifyToml (which would drop the comments).
Keep orch_context_window commented: uncommenting it would pin the value and defeat the read-with-default path; a commented example both documents and preserves default behavior.
Keep the accepted-value enums in the comments in sync with the actual readers in src/config/models.ts (auto|observe|off; container|host); do not invent values.
